page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8488C processor. This x86_64 architecture system features 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. The server operates on the Nitro hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results show strong performance across memory bandwidth and compute-intensive tasks. The server achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 19030.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 65056.32. Memory read-only bandwidth for small cached blocks reached 4111.32 GB/sec, while large uncached block writes measured 95.0 GB/sec. In cryptography and compression tests, the system demonstrated high throughput, including a static web serving throughput of 72.85 GB/sec and a Redis SET performance of 62.18 million operations per second.

The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning and matrix operations. This hardware acceleration contributes to strong LLM inference speeds, such as 353.0 tokens per second for text generation using a small 135M model and 30.87 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. Given the compute-heavy profile, 9 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and lack of local storage, this server is suited for CPU-bound workloads such as software compilation, database operations, web serving, and lightweight machine learning inference.
